steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You wrote the letter? You wanted me to come here?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes, my child. I even wanted to go looking for you myself.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: But time is short, so I had no choice but to have a friend deliver that letter to... Rhodes Island. Yes, Rhodes Island, that's what it was.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: And after the disaster... I heard that organization took you in. Have they been treating you well?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They are... my family.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, Amiya, the Doctor, Blaze, Raidian... and everyone in the squad, they're all my family.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: So you mean... you've found a new family...*cough* *cough*
The frail man coughs violently, and his naturally crooked body seems to droop even lower.
He stares at Rosmontis, as if wanting to go move to her, but a thin wall of water stops him in his tracks.
Muelsyse knows who he is, and so do you. This is the very same name that cropped up many times in Rosmontis's files.
The criminal that should have been well behind bars has suddenly appeared before you, acting as a grandparent rushing to visit his grandchild after work.

options: You came here alone... to find Rosmontis?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: This is what I wanted. Nothing to do with anyone else.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Let me... let me get a good look at you...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You've grown up, girl.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Over the past four years... no, it should be five soon enough...? I've thought of you so many times while we've been apart.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Whenever I think about the time we were separated from each other, I just feel so... sorry.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I'm sorry... that I couldn't protect you from them. Those mediocre hacks with their superficial goals... they destroyed the future we could have had together.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: A future? Were we supposed to live together?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But I don't remember you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Um... should I have remembered this? I record everything I don't want to forget in my terminal.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You've forgotten who I am? Have you lost all your memories, and forgotten the wrongs I've done?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Are you a bad man? Did you do something bad to me?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: That's not for me to answer, my child. It would make this meeting meaningless.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Your memory loss... it should not have been an effect of the experiments. Could there have been another party? Maylander, or perhaps Rhine?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't aim those eyes my way, Mr. Williams. I'm just the teensy weensy Director of Ecological.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Besides, even if the old goat was here, his precarious code of ethics wouldn't be any worse than yours, right?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: This has nothing to do with ethics.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Rhodes Island, did you wipe the girl's memories and manipulate her emotions?

options: I won't dignify that with a response.
It's not something Rhodes Island would do.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes, you couldn't have done that. It was my work after all... I was so meticulous that no one could have possibly stripped away such an important part of her when her vitals were functioning normally.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Oh, I see now... it was me after all? Perhaps I didn't make enough observations... Yes... We didn't have the luxury of time... The pressure of consciousness is honestly beyond anything a layman could comprehend...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Or could it be... that you passed your memories onto your sibling?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... don't know how to answer you.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: There must be a way, let me think...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Any fragment of that incident is beyond meaningless, same as the records and data, they all belong in the garbage dump. But emotions, shapes, scents... oh yes, smells, that's it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: A... floral scent?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: This smells like... crushed juice... smeared on the walls, and on my hands...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Stop, stop thinking about it! I don't want this!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes, I knew it! I'm still somewhere in your memories!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Please, child, bring out those memories, remember your hatred for me, let your anger fill your body, your mind, your omnipresent spirit!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Hurting her?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: No, her pain comes from the past, not the present. I only want to give her the gift she's been longing for.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Do you actually understand her pain?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Everything you know about her and her experiences is second-hand information from Maylander. Don't you think she has the right to be angry, to hold resentment?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Oh, I know. Haha, both you and Maylander are walking the same path. You want her easy to control, because you're afraid of her, afraid of...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: ...A weapon of reignited anger.
'Weapon.'
Everything you experienced with Rosmontis in Chernobog comes flooding back before your eyes. The fights desperate with determination to live alongside the pain of farewells.
Yes, you've heard the term used many a time in the past to describe the Feline girl by your side. She felt it was harsh before, but this time it's unbearable.
Because it came out of Loken Williams's mouth, the root cause that led Rosmontis here in the first place.
You have many ideas on how to refute his claims. It also occurs to you that if Kal'tsit were here, she would be capable of coming up with an even more extensive response.
But another thought comes to mind before your words.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Gah...*cough*...haha...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I see you're outraged by my words, that's fine. You're not willing to think of her as a 'weapon.' But, just look at her... She's standing in front of you, even wielding a sword for you.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Gah...*cough*...haha...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I see you're outraged by my words, that's fine. You're not willing to think of her as a 'weapon.' But, just look at her... She's standing in front of you, even wielding a sword for you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, please get behind me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: My sword might be about to pierce through the building's outer wall.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Enemies.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There are enemies closing in quickly.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I will protect you, Doctor. My mind still feels like... it's a mess. up. But Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya told me my mental state is a lot more stable now. They allowed me to protect you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: And this is one thing I can definitely do.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Doctor... of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: If you truly care for her, then you should know what she really needs.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Just ask yourself this... what are you trying to protect? A soldier that would die for you, or a child with a traumatic past?
The question is not difficult to answer, but it is obvious that Loken is not interested in your reply.
From the moment he stepped into the room, he has been staring directly at the white Feline girl next to you, his turbid gaze full of enthusiasm, sorrow, and a certain kind of anticipation.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They're here!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Such a pity that this is the end of our meeting.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You're not ready yet, my child... but I know you will be.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I'll be waiting for you at 'home.'

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You actually caught up... no, you were waiting for me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Which one of you is your true self? The silent one in the room earlier, or the one right here?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's not important.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Your Originium Arts are quite interesting, or perhaps... no, forget it, I don't have time for this curiosity.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Do you have business with me, Director of Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Where's Kristen?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Ah...... but you're the Rhine one here. Are you sure you should be asking me that?

spans.text: the Rhine one here. Are you sure you should be asking me that?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The only way you could have gotten out of prison is with her help.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Your being here means the work she entrusted to you is already complete.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: She's done preparing, right? She's really planning to...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Pitiful girl.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm not about to let a rotten geezer who looks like he hasn't showered in three days call me pitiful.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Astonished, unwilling, and anxious... you're afraid, little girl. You're afraid of being betrayed by those you trust, and of being abandoned by others.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Well, the worst is your confusion... You're at such a complete loss that you have no choice but to ask an 'outsider' like me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Such a familiar feeling it is...*cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: When my teacher handed all my research to Maylander, when he expelled me from the academy...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: When my students submitted all my data to the military before I did, and I had to speed up my experiments, leading to that ultimate failure...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: When my family sold everything we had in D.C. and disappeared...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I saw that very same look in the mirror.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...My eye bags can't be that bad?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I just don't get it... why would she trust that wretched woman from Maylander and you over Saria, or... ugh....

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Are you stalling for time here? If you're waiting for Ho'olheyak to pick you up, I won't necessarily lose, you know?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You don't want me for an enemy, girl.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Do you really think you could stop Kristen and I just by catching up to me?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Or, maybe...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You want to catch me, to catch... Kristen?
Muelsyse falls into a daze. Loken turns his back and yet she still doesn't act.
Only when the familiar wind caresses her face so mockingly does she realize that Loken is no longer anywhere to be seen on the streets.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I let him go... what am I doing...?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, Doctor.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm... I'm right here, heard everything you said crystal clear, yessiree.

options: Did your clone manage to stop Loken?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Clone...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: My... *ahem* Yes, my clone outside.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor, you guessed right. They couldn't have let such a terminally ill old man come here by himself.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Before his assistants got him away, I only managed to get one thing—Loken Williams is definitely involved in Kristen's plans.

options: The secret that Maylander and the army are scrambling for.
And they're pointing right at Kristen Wright's hideout.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, your terminal... there's a new message?

options: Maylander has some new information to share with us.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What a coinkydink, I was just wondering when we were gonna see the Tin Man again.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You got roughed up by the army because of him, so it's only right that he should make it up to you, isn't it?

options: Rosmontis, are you ready to proceed with the mission?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yeah, I'm fine.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ah... haha... our cooperation is far from over, so you're going to wear out those words if keep standing on ceremony, you know?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor... do you really trust me so much?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Nothing. Alright, let's get moving.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence, is the temperature okay... not too hot?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You're controlling it very well.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria's body temperature has stabilized, and she should be out of danger.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ifrit, you should rest for a bit. Using Originium Arts for a long time will wear you out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: No, I'm staying with Saria.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I still remember back in the white room... she kept me company when I was stuck in that bed.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I was always in pain, my mind was totally messed up, and I couldn't stop myself from burning everything I saw.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I don't even have a clear picture of every visit, I just know that every time I opened my eyes, she would there at my bedside, and I felt so relieved.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So now I want to stay here and keep her company. Even though she won't open her eyes... I'm sure she can feel that I'm here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I'm sure she can.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She just needs... a bit more sleep.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Something still feels off.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I just realized Saria isn't that much taller than I am. And also... her palms are soft, with such pretty nails too. Just like your hands, Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria is... of course, an ordinary human.
I'm afraid she's quite far from 'ordinary.'

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Jara...

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: She prefers to solve problems by herself, without a word. She always keeps a straight face that deters people from voicing their opinions.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Would you like to make a guess just how many employees from Defense I had to offer psychological counseling year after year?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Are you... unhappy with Saria?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Unhappy? Hmph.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: One year I asked Kristen if she was set on transferring a researcher to make the head of the Defense Section—Guess what the woman there did when she found out?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: She threw three dozen listening devices onto my desk, and right in my face, shattered them to pieces with her newly developed Arts.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: An unfortunate thing, as a couple of them were operating on behalf of some of our dear government departments.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: They were just a little wary of such a rapidly-progressing tech company.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I was happy to share some 'controllable' information with them, to get them to ease up a little.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I spent some time dealing with the trouble that came with the incident... but who could deny the determination and skill of that young Vouivre?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I guess... Saria has always been like that.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Sure enough, many years have come and gone, and if you compare her then and now, it doesn't seem like there's been much development.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She's the most resolute and determined woman I know.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Who ever said she wasn't? I've watched she and Kristen walk their paths, and I'm well aware just how decisive and strong she is.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But even such an outstanding individual can't stand against... the whole damned country. If you let her take on these obstacles she hasn't overcome in all this time, she'll only be smashed to bits.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Car keys...?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Take Saria and Ifrit and leave, before it's too late.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria... wouldn't want that.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: No, she wouldn't. But I'm not talking to Saria right now.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Aren't you the type to go 'innocent lives shouldn't be put at risk?' This girl shouldn't be involved, and neither should you. No one needs to die here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I need... a bit more time.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Jara?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I'm afraid we're all out of time. Take the secret passageway out, now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: An old friend has come knocking.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: This conference room...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Whenever we had meetings, Parvis would sit by the window, Muelsyse likes to sit in the middle, and you... Director Jara, you sit here, furthest from Kristen.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: And you're the same as before, always standing behind somebody else's seat.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Hm... how nostalgic.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Would you like something to drink? Red wine, or should we pop open the champagne?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Is there an occasion?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Of course. Mr. Ferdinand Clooney is enjoying a career upgrade, and also returned to Rhine Lab... Sounds like a cause for celebration?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You think I'm here as the army's guide?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, they have their own plans for Rhine, and I don't approve at all. Because I know that if something happens to the Vice President while he's here, that's the end of the company.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Kristen can ignore the existence of Rhine Lab, but not me.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The event today went off without a hitch.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Don't play dumb with me, Jara.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You may not know just what kind of people run the army. They could repeat today's adventure anytime they want.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: So before those savages rip a dozen years' worth of time and effort to shreds, can you just tell me the truth—what exactly is Kristen doing?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Did Colonel Blake not tell you?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The very first day Dr. Wright disappeared, I handed every document about Control and her projects right over to them.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: And for the record, it happened more than once. I worked days of overtime just for this.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Heh, 'Dr. Wright,' as if you two have the most ordinary collaborative relationship.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Should I show Blake the picture hidden in the darkest corner of your office drawer?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Or has our dear HR Director already come up with an explanation for why she's hidden the New Year's card little Kristen wrote her two decades ago?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: ...That's just an old photo.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Kids aren't as cute and well-behaved after they grow up. Ferdinand, you know that better than me. That sock in the jaw at Site 359 still smarting?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: ...Heh.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: She's gone into hiding, like a child clinging to her favorite toy. Except it's not a toy, it's a goddamned superweapon, with some real forbidden secrets behind it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: So you should find and drag her out, if you still care about her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Or would you rather watch her die for the vaguest of ideals?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Even if... I couldn't bear to watch her go that far ahead, how do you suppose that stopping her is within my power?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: This is Kristen we're talking about, Ferdinand. She'll take everything you have.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Do you think she would ever leave such a major weakness—if you really want to treat the relationship between me and her as a vulnerability—so easily within your grasp?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Good... great. You refuse to cooperate.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And what about the others? For example...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Saria.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You rescued her, and you've hidden her somewhere around here.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You're so willing to talk to me, just to buy her more time to escape.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Let's say she manages to escape. Who could she even go to?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Rhodes Island, caught up in the same mess, or that group of Maylander agents who love spinning webs just as much as you do?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The military just picked up a new piece of intelligence.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Saria... as well as the company behind her, Rhodes Island, are suspected of helping Kristen steal classified information pertaining to national security.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Maybe working at Rhine Lab for more than a decade has made you naive enough to... assume your old boss was some hero of justice?
